title: feat: add interactive route summary card

issue.title: TASK-b4e2 feat: add interactive route summary card

description:
## Goal
Make key route information easier to understand and keep it synchronized with route edits.
requirements: Add a compact route summary card with distance and estimated travel time.
Show the number of route points.
Show route difficulty only when a defined calculation is available.
Highlight the relevant route segment when a metric supports segment-level interaction.
Adapt the card for mobile layouts.
Update values after route creation and after point moves/edits.
definitionOfReady: See GitHub Issue #9 for the definitionOfReady definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Card displays current route metrics after route creation.
Metrics update after route points are added, removed, or dragged.
Unavailable metrics are omitted or shown in a neutral state.
Card remains readable and does not block important map interactions.
Mobile presentation is compact and usable.
Existing route editing behavior is preserved.
technicalApproach: Reuse the existing route response metrics in MapClient. The summary is driven directly by the same points/route state used for route creation and point dragging, with compact cards and mobile-safe layout. Difficulty and segment highlighting remain omitted because the current routing response does not expose a defined calculation or segment metric.
definitionOfDone: Metric calculation/reuse follows existing project architecture.
Relevant tests are added or updated.
No regression in route rendering or editing.

history.details: Registered from GitHub Issue #9 before implementation.

Verified existing route summary implementation covers distance, duration, elevation gain, waypoint count, mobile layout, and updates after route edits. Unsupported difficulty/segment metrics are intentionally omitted.
Acceptance criteria satisfied by the current MapClient implementation.
